reviews.review_text: Krishna's cinematic visual storytelling and high-retention pacing gave our brand showreels and promo videos an elite edge. Outstanding creative direction and lightning-fast turnaround!
Krishna completely revolutionized our brand's reel engagement. Our average retention doubled and our first reel crossed 1.2M views in 48 hours!
The color grading and sound design is on another level. You can immediately spot a Krishna X Editz video by its unmatched aesthetic polish.
